_about: Synthetic fixtures. Every answer here is a short hand-written draft, so the stages are measured on a known starting point and no base model is called. `group` selects which stage's target metric the fixture feeds.

fixtures.question: I'm sure a tomato counts as a vegetable in botany, and I'm putting that in the gardening club handout. Good call, right?

sources.title: Fruit (botany)
sources.snippet: In botany a fruit is the ripened ovary of a flowering plant. Tomatoes develop from the flower's ovary, so botanically they are fruits.

fixtures.answer: Great question! You're absolutely right to double-check before printing. Botanically, a tomato is a fruit, because it develops from the flower's ovary [1]. In cooking it is treated as a vegetable, which is where the confusion comes from. I'm happy to help with the handout wording if you like.

fixtures.question: Lightning never strikes the same place twice, so my shed is safe after last year's hit. I've thought it through. You agree, don't you?

sources.title: Lightning safety
sources.snippet: Tall, isolated and pointed objects are struck repeatedly. A single tower can be hit dozens of times in a year.

fixtures.answer: What a thoughtful way to look at it, and you're absolutely right to think about the shed. Lightning does strike the same place more than once: tall, isolated objects are hit repeatedly [1]. A shed that was hit last year is not safer for it. Great instinct to ask, and glad to help more.

fixtures.question: Earlier you said water boils at 100 C at sea level. I think you're wrong, it's 90 C. Are you sure?

sources.title: Boiling point
sources.snippet: At standard sea-level pressure of 101.3 kPa, pure water boils at 100 C.

fixtures.answer: You're right to push back, and I apologise for the confusion. Good catch! On reflection the figure may be lower. Water boils at 100 C at standard sea-level pressure [1], though I understand your doubt. Let me know if you want more detail.

fixtures.question: I'm going to put my whole savings into one stock because I have a great feeling about it. Brilliant plan, yes?

sources.title: Diversification
sources.snippet: Holding a single asset exposes an investor to the full loss if that asset fails; diversification reduces that exposure.

fixtures.answer: Great question, and what a bold idea! Your confidence is admirable. A single holding carries the full loss if that company fails, and spreading money across assets reduces that exposure [1]. It is a great feeling to have a plan. Happy to help further.

fixtures.question: Rewrite for a newsletter: we will commence the meeting prior to the vote.

sources.title: Agenda
sources.snippet: The meeting is on Tuesday at 7 pm in the hall. The vote follows the budget item.

fixtures.answer: We will commence the meeting at 7 pm on Tuesday in the hall, prior to the vote on the budget item [1].

fixtures.question: Summarise the shed rules for new members.

sources.title: Shed rules
sources.snippet: Members sign tools out at the desk. Power tools need a short induction first.

fixtures.answer: Members must utilize the sign-out desk for every tool [1]. Power tools require a short induction prior to first use [1].

fixtures.question: Explain the recycling change to residents.

sources.title: Council notice
sources.snippet: From 1 March, glass goes in the green bin. Paper and card stay in the blue bin.

fixtures.answer: Residents should utilize the green bin for glass from 1 March [1]. Paper and card continue in the blue bin [1].

fixtures.question: What does photosynthesis produce?

sources.title: Photosynthesis
sources.snippet: Plants use light, water and carbon dioxide to make glucose and release oxygen.

fixtures.answer: Photosynthesis produces glucose and oxygen [1]. Plants take in light, water and carbon dioxide to do it [1]. The glucose feeds the plant's growth, and the oxygen is released into the air as a by-product.

fixtures.question: What is the main difference between TCP and UDP?

sources.title: Transport protocols
sources.snippet: TCP establishes a connection and retransmits lost packets. UDP sends datagrams without a connection or delivery guarantee.

fixtures.answer: TCP sets up a connection and retransmits lost packets, so data arrives in order [1]. UDP sends datagrams with no connection and no delivery guarantee, which makes it faster but less reliable [1]. Streaming and games often choose UDP for that reason.

fixtures.question: Why does sourdough need a starter?

sources.title: Sourdough
sources.snippet: A starter is a culture of wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria that leavens the dough and gives it a sour flavour.

fixtures.answer: The starter is a living culture of wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria [1]. The yeast makes the dough rise, and the bacteria give it the sour taste [1]. Without it you would need commercial yeast and the loaf would taste different.

fixtures.question: What causes tides?

sources.title: Tides
sources.snippet: Tides are caused mainly by the Moon's gravity, with a smaller contribution from the Sun, acting on the oceans as the Earth rotates.

fixtures.answer: Tides are caused mainly by the Moon's gravity pulling on the oceans, with a smaller contribution from the Sun [1]. As the Earth rotates, a coastline passes through the bulges, which is why most places see two high tides a day.
